title: RamanPFN: learning from Raman spectral structure with a tabular foundation model
abstract: arXiv:2608.02157v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Raman spectroscopy enables label-free molecular characterization across materials science, analytical chemistry, biomedicine, and industrial process monitoring. However, machine learning for high-dimensional spectroscopy remains constrained by limited labelled data and a mismatch between the physical organization of spectra and feature-agnostic models. Channel coverage alone does not ensure that related bands share a common inference context. Here we present RamanPFN, a general-purpose spectral foundation framework that enables unified in-context inference through physics-guided spectral learning. It captures full-spectrum compositional covariation via Global Compositional Unmixing (GCU), which decomposes distributed, multi-band mixture signatures into shared non-negative latent bases. translated_title: RamanPFN：利用表格基础模型从拉曼光谱结构中学习
translated_abstract: 拉曼光谱能够在材料科学、分析化学、生物医学和工业过程监测等领域实现无标记的分子表征。然而，面向高维光谱的机器学习仍然受到标注数据有限以及光谱物理组织结构与特征无关模型之间不匹配的制约。仅有信道覆盖并不能确保相关谱带共享一个共同的推理上下文。在此，我们提出了RamanPFN，一个通用的光谱基础框架，通过物理引导的光谱学习实现统一的上下文推理。它通过全局成分解混捕捉全光谱的成分协变关系，将分布式、多谱带的混合特征分解为共享的非负潜在基。同时，它通过局部振动子空间编码解析局部振动结构，保留细粒度的峰……
tldr: 提出RamanPFN——一个通过物理引导的光谱学习（结合全局成分解混GCU与局部振动子空间编码LVSE）实现统一上下文推理的通用拉曼光谱基础模型框架。
en_tdlr: RamanPFN is a general-purpose spectral foundation framework that enables unified in-context inference for Raman spectroscopy through physics-guided spectral learning, combining Global Compositional Unmixing (GCU) and Local Vibrational Subspace Encoding (LVSE).
